roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, while also leading our infection control initiatives. Your expertise will directly contribute to a healthy and compliant environment, making a significant impact on our facility's success and the well-being of those we serve. This is an urgent opening for a professional ready to make a difference.

We offer a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to work in a supportive and dynamic setting. If you are passionate about staff development and infection control, and meet the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing efforts for a recently acquired center, playing a pivotal role in its growth and success. We are looking for a highly motivated individual with a strong drive for results.

As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance community presence and drive census growth. Your ability to build strong relationships and represent the facility professionally will be key to your success in this impactful leadership role.

This position requires flexibility, including the ability to work occasional weekends to meet business needs and engage with the community.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills
Strong business development acumen and a results-oriented approach
Ability to work occasional weekends as required
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance, with excellent pay for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN work while providing essential therapy services to patients in a supportive environment. You will play a vital part in helping individuals regain and improve their communication and swallowing abilities.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment. Additionally, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available to qualified candidates, recognizing the immediate need for your skills.

Join a team committed to patient-centered care and make a significant difference in the lives of those you serve. This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP looking for flexible hours and a rewarding professional experience.
requirements: Current Florida SLP license or eligibility
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
